why: Replacing C7 to demote cuts that separate scope-bearing operators made the model avoid cutting immediately after verbs/modals/negation and instead shift cuts rightward into their complements or inside noun/prepositional phrases; that reduced contradictions in some long/clause-level cases but produced more bad tiny fragments overall, with the harm concentrated in short–medium latency bins (≤5 and ≤7) as shown by the by_bin and the larger n_worse than n_better.
lesson: A later revision should keep scope-bearing operators attached when necessary but not indiscriminately push cuts into short/medium-length complements or inside noun/prepositional phrases (the ≤5–≤7 bins), since that rightward shift creates many small, low-cohesion fragments.
